name: Ameren-EMRT Big Hollow Project
monitor_reason: no data center tie: the pipeline is 9.6 miles (about 15 km, under 25 km) and no loaded page names this pipeline and ties it to a data center
researcher_notes: This is a real project with a sponsor, endpoints and a concrete step, but it fails the data center rule. Enable Mississippi River Transmission filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission under docket CP26-2 for a 9.6 mile, 20 inch lateral from its Mainlines 2 and 3 at mile post 415.5 in Monroe County, Illinois to the Big Hollow Energy Center in Jefferson County, Missouri. The Energy Information Administration August 2026 pipeline projects workbook (Natural Gas Pipeline Projects sheet, Excel row 6) lists it as Approved, 200 MMcf/d added, in service 2028, and it states the pipeline serves an 800 megawatt power plant. A St. Louis Public Radio story from February 2026 says the Missouri commission approved the plant in part to power expected data centers. That story does not mention the pipeline. The trade press story and the federal notice do not mention data centers. The tie is through the plant owner's load forecast, so DataCenter stays blank. Not an existing row: Mississippi River Transmission (P0162) is the whole system with no segment for this lateral. If a filing, Ameren, Energy Transfer or a hyperscaler later names this lateral as serving a data center, add it as an expansion row under Mississippi River Transmission.
